def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # convert text-encoded numbers
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass (values in grams should be <= 6500; 3650000 looks like a scale error)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # sex missing means unknown; leave as NaN (not needed for the question)
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
